invitations.revokeBody: {{email}} will no longer be able to join with this invitation.

riders.title: Riders
riders.subtitle: Approve, review and manage delivery riders and their cash deposits.

approve.title: Approve this rider?
approve.body: {{name}} will be able to go online and take deliveries. Say why.

reject.title: Reject this rider?
reject.body: {{name}}'s application will be rejected. Say why.

suspend.title: Suspend this rider?
suspend.body: {{name}} will not be able to take deliveries. Say why.

reactivate.title: Reactivate this rider?
reactivate.body: {{name}} will be able to take deliveries again. Say why.

confirm.title: Confirm this deposit?
confirm.body: Confirm that the cash from {{name}} was received.

reject.title: Reject this deposit?
reject.body: The cash from {{name}} was not received. A note is required.

riderPay.title: Rider pay & policy
riderPay.subtitle: Set the pay rate card and rules per city. Type amounts in rupees.
riderPay.noCities: No cities are set up yet.
riderPay.noRateCard: No rate card for this city yet. Saving will create one.
riderPay.noPolicy: No policy for this city yet. Saving will create one.
riderPay.invalidAmount: Enter valid numbers (rupees with at most 2 decimals).

commission.title: Commission rules
commission.subtitle: What the platform earns on orders. Rules are versioned: an edit creates a new version and keeps the old one in history.
commission.versionNote: Saving deactivates the current rule and creates a new version. History is kept.
commission.deactivateBody: The rule stops applying to new orders. It stays in history.
commission.versioned: New version saved. The old version is deactivated.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Every order on the platform. Read-only: open one to see its full story.

dispatch.title: Dispatch board
dispatch.subtitle: Delivery jobs by state. Refreshes every 30 seconds.

reassign.title: Reassign this delivery?
reassign.body: The current rider is removed and the job goes back out for assignment. Say why.

cancel.title: Cancel this delivery?
cancel.body: The delivery job is cancelled. Say why.

settlements.subtitle: Run settlements, approve them and mark payouts paid. The person who creates an item cannot approve it.
settlements.title: Settlements
settlements.approveBody: You approve a net amount of {{amount}}. This creates payouts.
settlements.debtOut: Shortfall carried to the next settlement
settlements.deliveryFeeKept: Delivery fees {{amount}} stay with One Local (it pays the riders).

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.paidBody: Enter the bank or UPI reference of the transfer you made. Money is not moved from here.

finance.title: Finance control
finance.subtitle: Money collected, earned, owed and paid. Posted entries are never deleted.
finance.reconNote: Read-only view. Differences are investigated, never edited here.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what, and when. Open an entry to see what changed.

integrations.subtitle: Registry of connected systems, field mappings and logs.
integrations.providerNote: Connecting, testing and syncing a real provider needs that provider to be configured. Until then those actions say so honestly. Records, mappings and logs are real.
integrations.rotateBody: The rotation is recorded. The old credentials stop working once the provider accepts the new ones.
integrations.disableBody: Syncing stops until it is enabled again. Say why.

api.title: API & webhooks
api.subtitle: API keys for partners, webhook endpoints, delivery attempts and request logs.

rotate.title: Rotate this key?
rotate.body: A new key is created for {{name}} and the old one stops working. You will see the new key once.

revoke.title: Revoke this app?
revoke.body: {{name}} will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.

keyOnce.title: Your new API key
keyOnce.warning: Copy this key now. It is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later.
keyOnce.label: API key
keyOnce.stored: I have stored this key somewhere safe.

webhooks.disableBody: No more events will be sent to this endpoint.
webhooks.secretRefHint: The NAME of the secret in the vault, never the secret itself.

applications.title: Partner applications
applications.subtitle: Businesses that signed up on the partner website. Approving one creates its organisation and makes the applicant its owner.
applications.searchPlaceholder: Business, owner, phone, email or reference

login.label: Partner app login
login.matchConfirmed: A login with this email exists; approving makes it the owner.
login.matchUnconfirmed: A login with this email exists but is not confirmed; approving sends the owner an invitation.
login.none: No login yet; approving sends the owner an invitation by email.

approve.title: Approve this partner?
approve.body: This creates the organisation for {{name}} and makes the applicant its owner. Ordering stays closed until the menu is ready.

reject.title: Reject this application?
reject.body: {{name}}'s application will be closed. Say why; the reason is kept on record.

done.approvedMember: Approved. The organisation was created and the applicant's login is its owner.
done.approvedInvited: Approved. The organisation was created and the owner was invited by email.
done.rejected: Rejected. The reason is on record.

holds.title: Held orders
holds.subtitle: Orders that looked unusual are held here. The restaurant sees nothing until someone releases or rejects them.
holds.searchPlaceholder: Store, organisation, city or order id

release.title: Release this order?
release.body: The order goes to the restaurant now and is dispatched as usual. Say why it is fine.

reject.title: Reject this order?
reject.body: The order is cancelled and any payment is refunded. Say why.

done.release: Released. The order is on its way to the restaurant.
